captions.gbp:
Waiting on insurance to approve your MRI? There's another way. With self-pay at our St. Petersburg 3T MRI, there is no authorization to wait for and no referral needed. You get one clear price: $295, or $395 with contrast, with the radiologist's reading included and no facility or reading fees added later. Same-day appointments are often available. Our 3 Tesla scanner has twice the magnet strength of a standard 1.5T MRI, giving finer detail for the brain, prostate and small joints, with no radiation, and results go to your doctor in 48 to 72 hours. If you have any implant, tell us before your scan, even if you've had an MRI before. Prefer to use insurance? We still verify your benefits and handle the authorization for you. Using Medicare or Medicaid? Ask us what applies to you. Visit us at 2201 Central Ave, Suite 100.

More at advancedimg.com. General information, not medical advice.

facts_checked: No ionizing radiation; loud knocking noise needs ear protection; implants must be MR Safe/MR Conditional: FDA MRI Benefits and Risks page. MR Conditional labeling lists permitted static field strength (e.g. 1.5T or 3.0T): FDA guidance 'Testing and Labeling Medical Devices for Safety in the MR Environment'. 3T = 2x 1.5T field, finer detail for brain/prostate/small joints, louder, prices $295/$395, no referral self-pay, same-day, St. Pete address: amiweb services-data.ts 3t-mri and mri entries, pricing page. Could not open the PubMed 1.5T vs 3T systematic review (rate limited). Checked 2026-10-14. Self-pay framing: pricing/page.tsx ('Skip prior authorizations, denials, and surprise bills. Know your price upfront'), services-data.ts MRI FAQ (self-pay same day, no authorization to wait for; with insurance we handle authorization), 3T 48-72h results. Dr. Patel quote drafted by Claude, needs his approval.
